topic: Slang at the cafe: "I'm down" vs textbook English

script.title: What natives mean by "I'm down"

lines.text: My textbook says: I would be happy to join you?
That's fine, but I'm down just means I'm in. Super casual.
Kit's tip: I'm down is for friends. At work, say I'd love to.

script.wrong: I would be happy to join you.
script.caption: Do you know "I'm down"?
